title: Ultrasound-assisted synthesis of novel 2-aryl-3-ethoxy-5-methyl-3-oxido-2H-thiazolo[2,3-e][1,4,2]diazaphosphole-6-carboxylates and their anticancer efficacy in inducing apoptosis and autophagy and targeting cell cycle progression
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37554-37569
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07173E, Paper

Wafa A. Bawazir, Tarik E. Ali, Mohammed A. Assiri, Ali A. Shati, Mohammad Y. Alfaifi, Serag E. I. Elbehairi
A novel class of ethyl 2-aryl-3-ethoxy-5-methyl-3-oxido-2H-thiazolo[2,3-e][1,4,2]diazaphosphole-6-carboxylates (2a–j) were synthesized via a one-pot, three-component method.
